facts.fact: Bran 冲她吼公寓里有老鼠。
facts.anchor: “There are RATS in my apartment!” Bran screams in my face.

facts.fact: 她建议打扫，并说自家没有老鼠。
facts.anchor: “Okay… Have you tried cleaning?” I ask. “I don’t have rats.”

facts.fact: 一声摔门让 Bran 跳出她的空间。
facts.anchor: But then a door slams, and Bran jumps back and out of my space.

facts.fact: Bran 向来人介绍：这就是那个坏运气的女人。
facts.anchor: “John! This is the bitch I keep telling you about, the one who is bad luck.”

facts.fact: 来人质问 Bran 是否要为她带来的霉运动手。
facts.anchor: “Surely you weren’t about to hit her for your bad luck?”

facts.fact: 她无法反驳 Bran 的说法，但对方根本不知道全部。
facts.anchor: I can’t argue, Bran isn’t wrong. Except he doesn’t even know the half of it.

facts.fact: John 皱了下眉但不受影响，微笑表示自己下班了。
facts.anchor: John flinches at the words but seems otherwise unphased. He offers me a reassuring smile. “I’m off duty.”
I’m not sure if the words are for me or Bran, but I shrug a shoulder and offer a hand. “Cinnamon. I live in 3D.”

facts.fact: 对面这栋楼里从没见过的侦探名叫 John Smith，住 3B。
她想说世界真小，却被他的香草味熏得说不出话。
facts.anchor: I want to make some witty response about it being a small world, but my tongue is tied as his vanilla scent wafts into my lungs.
“You’ll see.” Bran is marching away now. “This isn’t over, Cinnamon.”

facts.fact: 她意识到自己还没问要做什么菜。
facts.anchor: That I never asked what I am supposed to be cooking.

facts.fact: 她对 John 夹在腋下的腊肠犬大喊好可爱。
facts.anchor: “You have the CUTEST WEEN!” I squeal as John comes back down the steps carrying a loaf of dog under his arm.

facts.fact: 狗扑向她，John 喊出狗的名字：Beanie。
facts.anchor: “Beanie, be a good girl. You know better than that.”

facts.fact: 她清楚：事故不是会不会发生，而是何时发生。
facts.anchor: It’s never a matter of if something will happen, like before, but when.
